create_reward_trainer: create a RewardTrainer to train a sequence classification reward model on preference data with chosen and rejected examples
build_data_collator_preference: build a DataCollatorForPreference that pads chosen and rejected token sequences into a single batch with attention masks
train_reward_model: train a reward model using preference data with margin-based loss and accuracy tracking on chosen versus rejected outputs
test_reward_trainer_evaluation: test the RewardTrainer evaluation loop that gathers rewards, computes accuracy, and logs min mean max reward metrics
refactor_reward_trainer_peft: refactor the RewardTrainer to wrap a model with PEFT configuration including trainable tokens and lm_head modules
